pages.title: Without the Last Hit
pages.text: Some useful materials can be collected while keeping the animal alive.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Shear bison; grass regrows fur. Shear snapping-turtle moss for scutes. Moose shed antlers naturally; fed anacondas shed skin. None of these material goals requires killing.
